title: MHZ Ship Builder - hatches pack
description: Schema for data/shapes/hatches.json. Hatch families are presets - an opening shape, a door style, and the params that size them (see the required top-level '_note'); ADR 0029 bores and doors them. Enforced by tools/ship_validate_data.gd.

_note.description: Must explain what a hatch family is - a preset naming the opening's shape and the door's style, bored and doored since ADR 0029 - and that before that every joint baked as the open studio hull.

description.description: What this hatch is, what it is for, what it looks like - real catalogue copy.

shape.description: The opening's outline (ShipSeams KIND_*), drawn inside the family's size params. A joint may override it.

style.description: The door over the opening (ShipSeams DOOR_*): one hinged leaf, two leaves meeting at the centre, or an iris of blades. A joint may override it.
